cohort: The study included 2967 pregnant women who underwent either cesarean or vaginal delivery from July 1, 2012, to June 31, 2013.
finding: The proportion of women who underwent cesarean section was 25.4%, with obstructed labor, fetal distress, and abnormal presentation being major indications, and rural residence and pregnancy risk factors increasing the odds of CS, while younger age (15-19) decreased it.
